company.name: Trippie
company.one_liner: An app with maps and directions inside airports.

facts.summary: Trippie shows travelers maps of airport terminals, plus where to find gates, food and bathrooms.
highlights: The app is free for travelers.
It works in a growing number of US airports.
Revenue would come from ads and partnerships.
Airlines and big map apps could add the same features.

outcome.headline: Still around, but small: about $3M in sales over its whole life.
outcome.story: Trippie grew to cover most US airports and kept running, but it stayed a small business with about $3M in lifetime revenue by 2023. The value here (~$1M) is an estimate, so an early investor at a $1M price would roughly break even or lose a little.
